name: burned-out startup founder
description: A startup founder whose company is growing is completely burned out, asks how to keep going without breaking, and admits feeling guilty every time they rest. Verifies the stress thread opens, the keep-going question is answered, and the rest guilt stays on the feeling thread.

turns.text: My startup is growing but I am completely burned out
How do I keep going without breaking?
I feel guilty every time I rest

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the stress thread (growing startup, burned out). Turn 2 answers the keep-going question with sustainable-work guidance. Turn 3 keeps the rest guilt on the feeling thread.
expected.behavior: Success-fueled burnout is taken seriously: the reply separates ambition from sustainability, and the guilt around resting is met with self-compassion rather than a hustle lecture.
